answer: The dune is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the signal. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, weighted by independent path length, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the reef of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
